subject.title: feat: improve chat transcript alignment and readability

question: Should the centered 48rem transcript frame become the default Control UI chat layout while preserving chatMessageMaxWidth as the operator override?
rationale: Tests can prove geometry and compatibility, but they cannot decide whether this denser transcript presentation is the desired default for all users; the linked issue is already marked as needing maintainer product review.

options.title: Adopt centered default
options.body: Land the centered transcript/composer frame after removing the changelog edit, keeping the existing width override for deployments that prefer another size.

options.title: Keep current default
options.body: Close or revise the PR and leave full-width transcript distribution as the default until another layout direction is chosen.

options.title: Narrow the rollout
options.body: Retain the implementation but require an explicit setting or experimental gate, adding configuration and upgrade complexity.

recommendation.title: Adopt centered default
recommendation.body: Land the centered transcript/composer frame after removing the changelog edit, keeping the existing width override for deployments that prefer another size.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked maintainer-authored issue defines the product intent and this person has adjacent merged Control UI ownership beyond merely opening this PR.
